name: Self-Harness
one_liner: An agent mines its failed runs, edits its own harness, and keeps an edit only if benchmark pass counts do not drop.

loop.proposes: Minimal edits to the agent's harness (its instructions and scaffolding), from the same fixed model
loop.judged_by: Benchmark verifiers on held-in and held-out splits; an edit passes only if neither split worsens and one improves
loop.steers: Failure patterns mined from traces drive the next proposals; accepted edits are merged and rejected ones stay out

headline_result: The paper reports that for three base models (MiniMax M2.5, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, GLM-5) across three benchmarks (Terminal-Bench-2.0, SWE-bench Verified, AppWorld) every final harness improves both held-in and held-out pass rates, with relative gains of up to 132%. On Terminal-Bench-2.0 held-out, MiniMax M2.5 went 40.5% to 61.9% and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 23.8% to 38.1%.
caveat: A candidate is promoted only if it improves the held-in or the held-out pass count without lowering the other, so the held-out split is not an untouched test of generalization. The Terminal-Bench work uses a 64-task subset of 89. The authors say edits may reflect benchmark-specific patterns and that higher-stakes changes need stronger gates. The text reports slightly different figures in two places.
beyond_harness_note: The product is a harness, which is the thing an agent harness is made of; the loop mostly shows a harness improving itself rather than going beyond one.
generative_model: Fixed base LLM (MiniMax M2.5, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B or GLM-5), no weight updates
algorithmic_authority: Benchmark task verifiers and a pass-count acceptance rule

verification.notes: Read the arXiv abstract page (v1 submitted 2026-06-08; latest v3 2026-08-20) and the v1 full text. Validation is algorithmic: a pass-count rule on verifier-graded splits (delta in >= 0, delta ho >= 0, at least one > 0), no LLM judge, so it passes the brief's condition. The table gives Qwen held-in +138% relative while the abstract says up to 132%; I used the abstract figure for the headline. SWE-bench and AppWorld numbers not read. VentureBeat coverage not opened. Org field is a placeholder, affiliations were not on the pages read. Org: the only affiliation printed in the arXiv HTML is Shanghai AI Laboratory; first author Hangfan Zhang (review 2026-11-03).
